value.syntax: # [doc = " One exact candidate, its clause verdicts and their structural witnesses."] # [doc = " Recognition does not imply a unique winner or a title transfer."] # [doc = " (´def:formation:settlement-recognition´)"] # [derive (Clone , Debug , PartialEq , Eq)] pub struct SettlementEvidence { # [doc = " Bid, exact Accept and Ratify, in handshake order."] pub acts : [ActId ; 3] , # [doc = " Accept-role and Ratify-role metadata, including the exact non-binding target."] pub references : [Option < SettlementReferences > ; 2] , # [doc = " Family and exact act-reference binding, independently of party correspondence."] pub targets_bind : bool , # [doc = " Party correspondence evidence, distinct from target binding failures."] pub partners : PartnerEvidence , # [doc = " Published placement and retained time for the three chain witnesses."] pub chain : [Option < ActMetadata > ; 3] , # [doc = " Observer-specific recomputation and stamp evidence, never a replacement stamp."] pub times : [Option < TimeEvidence > ; 3] , # [doc = " Item named by a valid Bid; absent for a wrong-family settles target."] pub item : Option < PublicReference > , # [doc = " Supplied prior owner, absent when the certificate resolves no owner."] pub prior_owner : Option < String > , # [doc = " Six clause verdicts, without short-circuiting failed consent."] pub clauses : BTreeMap < RecognitionClause , bool > , # [doc = " Buyer Withdraw identities at or before the Ratify boundary."] pub withdrawals : Vec < ActId > , # [doc = " Seller Rescind identities at or before the Ratify boundary."] pub rescissions : Vec < ActId > , # [doc = " Candidate records already consumed at an earlier boundary."] pub consumed : BTreeSet < ActId > , # [doc = " All clauses hold and no candidate record was previously consumed."] pub recognized : bool , }
